transfer.receiver is a parameter used only by transfer and can be folded into the transfer core function node.
transfer.numTokens is a parameter used only by transfer and its arithmetic operations; fold it into the transfer core function node.
approve.delegate is a parameter used only by approve; fold it into the approve core function node.
